name: @dylankuhlenthal/porch
description: Wake any agent session with a message and read its state, across harnesses.
author: Dylan Kuhlenthal

scripts.//build: Compile TypeScript from src/ into dist/.
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && chmod +x dist/cli/main.js
scripts.//typecheck: Type-check src/ and tests/ without writing output.
scripts.//lint: ESLint over the given files, or the whole repo with no arguments. CI runs it on everything.
scripts.//test: Unit, contract, replay and fake-adapter conformance tests. Builds first because the CLI tests run dist/cli/main.js.
scripts.//conformance: Run the conformance suite against one harness: npm run conformance -- --harness fake [--record]. See docs/patterns/conformance.md.
scripts.//prepare: Build after npm install, so installing from git (before Porch is on npm) gets dist/, and packing always has a fresh build.
